title: Implement UI components from @object-ui/types
body:
## Implementation Plan

- [x] Add `@object-ui/types` as a dependency to `@object-ui/components` package
- [x] Update form component renderers to use types from `@object-ui/types`:
  - [x] button.tsx - use `ButtonSchema`
  - [x] input.tsx - use `InputSchema`
  - [x] textarea.tsx - use `TextareaSchema`
  - [x] select.tsx - use `SelectSchema`
  - [x] checkbox.tsx - use `CheckboxSchema`
  - [x] radio-group.tsx - use `RadioGroupSchema`
  - [x] switch.tsx - use `SwitchSchema`
  - [x] toggle.tsx - use `ToggleSchema` ✅ Fixed fallback logic
  - [x] slider.tsx - use `SliderSchema`
  - [x] file-upload.tsx - use `FileUploadSchema`
  - [x] date-picker.tsx - use `DatePickerSchema`
  - [x] calendar.tsx - use `CalendarSchema` ✅ Removed `as any`
  - [x] input-otp.tsx - use `InputOTPSchema`
  - [x] form.tsx - use `FormSchema`
- [x] Update layout component renderers to use types from `@object-ui/types`
  - [x] card.tsx - use `CardSchema`
  - [x] container.tsx - use `ContainerSchema`
  - [x] flex.tsx - use `FlexSchema`
  - [x] grid.tsx - use `GridSchema`
  - [x] tabs.tsx - use `TabsSchema`
- [x] Update basic component renderers to use types from `@object-ui/types`
  - [x] div.tsx - use `DivSchema`
  - [x] text.tsx - use `TextSchema`
  - [x] span.tsx - use `SpanSchema`
  - [x] image.tsx - use `ImageSchema`
  - [x] icon.tsx - use `IconSchema`
  - [x] separator.tsx - use `SeparatorSchema`
- [x] Update data-display component renderers to use types from `@object-ui/types`
  - [x] alert.tsx - use `AlertSchema`
  - [x] badge.tsx - use `BadgeSchema`
  - [x] avatar.tsx - use `AvatarSchema`
  - [x] list.tsx - use `ListSchema`
  - [x] markdown.tsx - use `MarkdownSchema`
  - [x] tree-view.tsx - use `TreeViewSchema`
  - [x] chart.tsx - use `ChartSchema`
- [x] Update feedback component renderers to use types from `@object-ui/types`
  - [x] loading.tsx - use `LoadingSchema`
  - [x] progress.tsx - use `ProgressSchema`
  - [x] skeleton.tsx - use `SkeletonSchema`
  - [x] toaster.tsx - use `ToasterSchema`
- [x] Update disclosure component renderers to use types from `@object-ui/types`
  - [x] accordion.tsx - use `AccordionSchema` ✅ Fixed property name
  - [x] collapsible.tsx - use `CollapsibleSchema`
- [x] Update overlay component renderers to use types from `@object-ui/types`
  - [x] dialog.tsx - use `DialogSchema`
  - [x] alert-dialog.tsx - use `AlertDialogSchema`
  - [x] popover.tsx - use `PopoverSchema`
  - [x] tooltip.tsx - use `TooltipSchema`
  - [x] hover-card.tsx - use `HoverCardSchema`
  - [x] sheet.tsx - use `SheetSchema`
  - [x] drawer.tsx - use `DrawerSchema`
  - [x] dropdown-menu.tsx - use `DropdownMenuSchema` ✅ Added type annotation
  - [x] context-menu.tsx - use `ContextMenuSchema` ✅ Added type annotation
- [x] Update navigation component renderers to use types from `@object-ui/types`
  - [x] header-bar.tsx - use `HeaderBarSchema`
  - [x] sidebar.tsx - use `SidebarSchema` ✅ Added type annotation
- [x] Update complex component renderers to use types from `@object-ui/types`
  - [x] kanban.tsx - use `KanbanSchema`
  - [x] carousel.tsx - use `CarouselSchema`
  - [x] calendar-view.tsx - use `CalendarViewSchema`
  - [x] filter-builder.tsx - use `FilterBuilderSchema`
  - [x] chatbot.tsx - use `ChatbotSchema`
  - [x] data-table.tsx - use `DataTableSchema` ✅ Removed duplicate type definition
  - [x] table.tsx - use `TableSchema` ✅ Added type annotation
  - [x] scroll-area.tsx - use `ScrollAreaSchema`
  - [x] resizable.tsx - use `ResizableSchema`
  - [x] timeline.tsx - use `TimelineSchema` ✅ Added type annotation
- [x] Build and test the changes
- [x] Address code review feedback

## Summary

This PR completes the integration of `@object-ui/types` into `@object-ui/components`, ensuring all 60 component renderers use proper TypeScript types from the centralized type definitions package. This improves type safety, maintainability, and follows the "Schema First" architecture principle of Object UI.

### Code Review Fixes Applied:
1. ✅ Removed `schema.body ||` fallback in toggle.tsx (now uses only `schema.children`)
2. ✅ Fixed accordion property name from `schema.type` to `schema.accordionType`
3. ✅ Removed `as any` type assertion in calendar.tsx
4. ✅ Added missing type annotations for: context-menu, dropdown-menu, table, sidebar, timeline
5. ✅ Removed duplicate DataTableSchema interface definition
